scope: Root directory page of prodi.unsrat.ac.id only (platform/template/halaman/akar.html, aset/css/akar.css, akar-tanpa-js.css, generated jalur.css). The 97 programme sites keep prodi.css + tokens.css and are not governed by this system.

lineColors.source: Faculty flags (bendera.dasar / bendera.tulisan) in www's unit data, written by platform/bangun/bangun.py (warna_jalur, css_jalur) to publik/aset/css/jalur.css as .jalur--<kode> { --jalur; --jalur-teks; --jalur-tepi }. Data, not tokens; CSP forbids inline styles.
lineColors.textRule: Flag lettering if >= 4.5:1 on the ground, else the first of white, #15123B, #000000 that reaches 4.5:1, else the best of them.
lineColors.edgeRule: Ground colour if it reaches 3:1 on white, else #15123B (WCAG 1.4.11).

narrative.overview:
The directory reads as a transit map. Each faculty (and the Program Pascasarjana) is one line drawn in its own flag colour, each programme is a stop on that line, and the search box is the destination. The page is white paper with one indigo-black ink. All colour comes from the faculty flags, drawn from www's unit data, and appears only as line material: the thick rail, the solid line head band, the jump badge.

Density is a printed timetable's, not an office table's. Every stop keeps a fixed column order (stop dot, name over degree, grade tag on the right), so a visitor scans down a line without reading across. Levels change on a line through a small monospaced label, like a zone marker. Overpass, the highway-sign family, sets everything, and Overpass Mono sets level labels and counts.

The interaction belongs to the map too. Typing filters the stops. Lines left empty fold away and their badges dim. Matching stops light once. When one programme is left, its stop grows into an arrival panel on its own line, with a single door, "Buka situs".
keyCharacteristics: Three inks besides the flags: white ground, ink `#15123b`, soft ink `#4b4966`; two quiet tints for hairlines and hover.
Faculty colour lives only in line material, never in running text.
Thick rails (0.625rem) with white stops ringed in ink.
A fixed stop row: dot column 3.25rem, name and degree, grade tag.
Flat; depth comes from lines and solid bands, not shadows.
Works without JavaScript: the whole map is always in the HTML, and search only narrows it.

rules.name: The Flags Only On Lines Rule
rules.body: A faculty colour fills only line material: the rail, the line-head band, the jump badge, the arrival band and rail, and a stop's light-up. Text, tags and buttons stay in ink.

rules.name: The Computed Lettering Rule
rules.body: Never hand-pick a text colour for a line. It comes from `warna_jalur`'s contrast ladder, so the next faculty flag from www lands legibly with no design work.

rules.name: The Ink Edge Rule
rules.body: A line under 3:1 against white gets an ink edge (an inset 2px ring in `--jalur-tepi`), so a white or near-white flag still reads as a line.

rules.name: The Mono For Codes Rule
rules.body: Overpass Mono sets only level markers and counts, the timetable's codes. Names and sentences are never monospaced.

rules.name: The Heavy Names Rule
rules.body: Names a visitor is looking for carry weight: 800 for line heads, the arrival name and tags, 600 for stop names. Secondary facts stay 400 in soft ink.

rules.name: The Line Is The Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a rail, a band or a hairline, never a drop shadow or a raised card.

dos: **Do** take every line colour from `aset/css/jalur.css` via `--jalur`, `--jalur-teks` and `--jalur-tepi`; add a faculty by updating www's unit data and rebuilding, not by writing CSS.
**Do** keep faculty colour on line material only (rail, head band, badge, arrival band, light-up) and keep all text, tags and buttons in `tinta`.
**Do** keep the stop row's fixed columns (3.25rem dot column, name over degree, tag right) on every line and at every width.
**Do** use a 3px `tinta` outline at a 3px offset for keyboard focus (1px offset on stop rows).
**Do** keep the full map in the HTML and treat search as a progressive filter from the separate `cari-prodi.js`; no inline scripts or styles.
**Do** gate every movement (badge lift, dot scale, light-up, arrival slide) behind `prefers-reduced-motion`, and animate movement rather than opacity so a paused animation never hides content.
donts: **Don't** introduce a colour beyond white, `tinta`, `tinta-lembut`, `garis`, `sorot` and the generated flag colours. UNSRAT blue `#3500ff` and yellow `#f2b705` from `tokens.css` are not part of this world (they appear here only where a faculty flag's own lettering uses them).
**Don't** put flag colour on running text, or rely on a flag colour alone to carry meaning.
**Don't** add drop shadows or raised cards; separate with rails, bands, borders and hairlines.
**Don't** monospace names or sentences; Overpass Mono is for level markers and counts.
**Don't** apply this stylesheet, these fonts or these tokens to the programme sites.
